title: Atlas TUI
objective: Deliver the first rich exploratory interface without duplicating engine logic.

stories.title: TUI shell and navigation
stories.outcome: Build keyboard-first terminal UI over engine query APIs.
acceptance_criteria: No direct filesystem/provider access from TUI crate.
All displayed actions derive from engine plans.
Works on tier-1 terminals with graceful capability fallback.
verification: Snapshot/render tests plus manual accessibility checklist.

stories.title: Machine and project atlas
stories.outcome: Show total footprint, reclaimable estimates, providers, projects, unattributed state, and top contributors.
acceptance_criteria: Logical and estimated reclaimable values are visually distinct.
Unknown/incomplete scans are prominent and never hidden in totals.
verification: Golden view models from fixture inventory.

stories.title: Artifact explain view
stories.outcome: Expose why an artifact exists, classification, evidence, risk, reversibility, allowed authority, and policy outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Every destructive recommendation has a human-readable explanation path.

stories.title: Plan review workflow
stories.outcome: Allow select/inspect/plan handoff while execution remains in the shared safety engine.
acceptance_criteria: TUI cannot mutate without a sealed engine plan.
Irreversible actions receive stronger confirmation than quarantine.

stories.title: The MSRV promise survives a dependency update
stories.outcome: Adding ratatui in E09-S01 pulled in instability and darling, whose newest releases require rustc 1.88, and the workspace promises 1.85.0 (ADR-0015). The MSRV leg of rust.yml has failed on all three platforms on every push since, while every stable leg stayed green - so the workflow was red on main across two release attempts and nobody read it. The cause is that resolver 2 does not look at rust-version at all: a routine resolution is free to pick a dependency the declared toolchain cannot compile. Resolver 3, available since Cargo 1.84 and therefore available to a workspace requiring 1.85, will not.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace shall resolve dependencies with the MSRV-aware resolver, so that a version above the declared rust-version is not selected.
No package in the lock file shall declare a rust-version above the workspace's own.
If a dependency has no version compatible with the declared MSRV, then the resolution shall fail visibly at update time rather than producing a lock file that only the MSRV job rejects.
The full Rust quality set shall pass unchanged: fmt, clippy with -D warnings, check, test and deny.
verification: cargo metadata reports no package whose rust_version exceeds 1.85.0.
cargo update reports the downgrades and names the constraint it applied.
cargo deny check accepts the new transitive dependency's license.
